title: Base overlays: list each changed non-Go or _test.go file with its own git show MERGEBASE:path command, and give a prompt-only diff the same hint

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Follow-up of S592 (run ork-20261126-004139-f69b). adj 596 (tool feedback, folded into S592 on 2026-11-26) asked that the Base overlays section give non-Go changed files such as role prompts a base-read command, or say that none applies. S592 landed one generic paragraph, `git -C WORKTREE show MERGEBASE:PATH`, with no paths, as its spec said.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-26. First, list each changed non-Go or `_test.go` file with its own `git show MERGEBASE:path` command (Jon chose 'Land generic, per-file later'). Second, give a diff with no non-test Go file (for example a prompt-only slice) the same hint; today the section is nil then (`internal/engine/baseoverlay.go:60-62`; S592 reviewer finding; Jon chose 'Fold hint into follow-up'). Third (key `base-overlays.other-files-list`, session 8d711f67): reuse `baseOverlayLimit` (20) with an "N more left out" line, and mark a changed file the base lacks (`notInBase`) as new in this slice, with no base version and no command.

Owner decision, 2026-11-26: adj 604 (reuse the 20-path cap with an N more left out line; a file the base lacks is marked new in this slice, no base version, with no command).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
All are in `internal/engine/baseoverlay_test.go`. They reuse `baseOverlayRoutes`, `baseOverlayShow`, `baseOverlayNotInBase`, `baseOverlayBody` and `baseOverlayEntries`. A per-file git show command is `git -C W show 'base:PATH'`, built as `"git -C " + ShellWord(W) + " show " + ShellWord("base:"+PATH)`. `ShellWord` quotes the colon, as `baseoverlay.go:88` already does.

- TestBaseOverlayNamesGitShowForNonGoFiles (changed; replaces the old assertions): the diff is `internal/x/x.go`, `internal/x/x_test.go`, `internal/roles/prompts/reviewer.md` and `README.md`, with a `git show` route for each. `baseOverlayEntries` still returns exactly one entry, for `x.go`. The body has one line per other file, in sorted path order (`README.md`, `internal/roles/prompts/reviewer.md`, `internal/x/x_test.go`). Each line starts with `- Other file` and holds the file's path in backticks and its own show command. The body keeps the "not overlaid" and "`git grep` is not available" paragraph. This replaces the old assertion that `reviewer.md` and `x_test.go` are absent.
- TestBaseOverlayOtherFileNewInSlice (new): `docs/new.md` is untracked and `baseOverlayNotInBase` answers for it. Its line says "new in this slice" and "no base version". The body has no show command for `docs/new.md` and no "incomplete".
- TestBaseOverlayOtherFileListLimit (new): 25 changed non-Go files (`docs/f01.md` to `docs/f25.md`, listed in reverse order) give exactly 20 `- Other file` lines, `f01` to `f20` in order. The body says "5 more changed other files were left out" and holds no `f21.md`. The Go entry count is unaffected.
- TestBaseOverlayPromptOnlyDiffGetsHint (replaces TestBaseOverlayNoSectionWithoutGoFiles): the diff is `internal/x/x_test.go`, `README.md` and `docs/a.go.md`. The brief now holds a Base overlays section with one show-command line per file and the "not overlaid" paragraph. It has no "Each command runs" intro. `TMPDIR/base` and `overlay-*.json` are absent. No `go vet` call is made. The `git show` calls are exactly those three paths.
- TestBaseOverlayNoNoteWithoutGoFiles (changed): with `Behind` true and a diff of `x_test.go` and `README.md`, the section is present and holds no "older than this slice's code" note, because it offers no `go` commands. The brief has no stand-alone note.
- TestBaseOverlayOtherFileUnreadable (new): `git show` for `README.md` exits 128 with "fatal: bad object base". The section says "incomplete" and names `README.md` in the notice that tells the reviewer to run `git show` itself. It holds no show-command line for `README.md`.
- TestBaseOverlayRejectsEscapingOtherFiles (new): the changed paths are `../evil.md` and `/abs/evil.md`. `git show` is never run. The section says "incomplete" and lists no `- Other file` line.
- TestBaseOverlayNoSectionWithoutChangedFiles (new): when the diff and the untracked list are empty, the reviewer brief has no Base overlays section. This keeps the nil result when nothing changed.

sections.heading: Implement
Check
sections.body:
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayNamesGitShowForNonGoFiles ./internal/engine` passes with ok.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayOtherFileNewInSlice ./internal/engine` passes with ok.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayOtherFileListLimit ./internal/engine` passes with ok.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayPromptOnlyDiffGetsHint ./internal/engine` passes with ok.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayNoNoteWithoutGoFiles ./internal/engine` passes with ok.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayOtherFileUnreadable ./internal/engine` passes with ok.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayRejectsEscapingOtherFiles ./internal/engine` passes with ok.
- `go test -run TestBaseOverlayNoSectionWithoutChangedFiles ./internal/engine` passes with ok.
- `go test ./...` passes.
- `go vet ./...` prints nothing and exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
